text: The only coverage in Belarus, apart from spills, is a single **walking trekker** in the historic centre of Minsk.
Instead of learning a lot of country-specific clues, it is more practical to simply memorise what the trekker looks like.
You can recognise trekkers by the fact that the camera feels a bit lower than the usual Google car. In Belarus’ case, the trekker is also mostly on pedestrian-only roads.
_You can find information about the border spill coverage in the [Spillover Guide](/spillover-countries)._
text_zh: 白俄羅斯除了跨境溢出之外，唯一的街景覆蓋是位於明斯克（Minsk）歷史中心的單一**徒步拍攝**。
與其學習大量特定國家的線索，不如直接記住徒步拍攝設備的外觀更為實用。
您可以透過相機感覺比一般的 Google 車稍微低一些來辨識徒步拍攝。以白俄羅斯為例，徒步拍攝也多半位於行人專用道上。
_您可以在 [Spillover 指南](/spillover-countries) 中找到有關邊境溢出街景覆蓋的資訊。_

text: The Minsk trekker features a **historic part of the city**, with well-maintained classical European architecture. Many buildings have white or pastel coloured walls. Most of the roads you see are pedestrian-only.
text_zh: 明斯克的徒步拍攝展示了**該市的歷史區域**，擁有維護良好的古典歐洲建築。許多建築都有白色或粉彩色的外牆。您看到的大多數道路都是行人專用道。

text: The Holy Spirit Cathedral features prominently in the coverage. Its two towers can often be seen from far away.
text_zh: 聖靈主教座堂（Holy Spirit Cathedral）在街景覆蓋中非常突出。從遠處經常可以看到它的兩座塔樓。

text: The pavement which the trekker walks on in Minsk is mostly **grey rectangular tiles**. On a small part, there are [pink-ish tiles](https://goo.gl/maps/jBJvXJYu2yqYENLw9) in a specific pattern.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝者在明斯克走的人行道大多是**灰色矩形地磚**。在小部分區域有呈特定圖案的[粉紅色系地磚](https://goo.gl/maps/jBJvXJYu2yqYENLw9)。

text: Signs will be in Belarusian or Russian. Both languages use the Cyrillic alphabet.
NOTE: The letters ў and і are not found in Russian.
text_zh: 指示牌會使用白俄羅斯語或俄語。兩種語言都使用西里爾字母。
備註：字母 ў 和 і 在俄語中看不到。

text: The Minsk centre street signs are **sea-green**, and can be seen almost everywhere.
NOTE: If you are close enough to the sign, you can make out the Cyrillic letters “вул (vul)”, the Belarusian name for “street”.
text_zh: 明斯克市中心的路牌是**海藍綠色**，幾乎隨處可見。
備註：如果你足夠靠近路牌，可以辨認出西里爾字母「вул (vul)」，這是白俄羅斯語中「街」的意思。
